First, note the date format given is MM-DD-YYYY: 04-20-1735.  
Subtract 38 days:  

April has 30 days.  
April 20 minus 20 days → April 0 (March 31).  
Remaining days to subtract: 38 - 20 = 18 days.  

March 31 minus 18 days:  
March has 31 days.  
March 31 minus 18 days = March 13.  

Check: From March 13 to April 20 is 38 days?  
March 13–31: 19 days (including 13th as day 1 of count).  
April 1–20: 20 days. Total = 39 days difference. Wait, that’s not right for subtraction. Let’s recalc carefully.

Better:  
Start: 1735-04-20.  
Subtract 20 days → 1735-03-31.  
Remaining to subtract: 38 - 20 = 18 days.  

From 1735-03-31, subtract 18 days:  
March has 31 days.  
March 31 - 18 days = March 13.  

Verify: March 13 to April 20:  
Days in March after March 13: 31 - 13 = 18 days (March 14–31 = 18 days).  
Plus April 20 days = 18 + 20 = 38 days. Correct.

No leap year issue (1735 not divisible by 4 in Gregorian calendar).  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1735-03-13
